waterReturn.delayTicksNote: Settled (brief NAT.03.03 lane-eb, Open questions settled): water credited to the return inventory rains back no earlier than 100 ticks later.
waterReturn.rainCpPerVisitNote: PM_DEFAULT: the most one receiver visit of the rain rotation delivers; about 3 mm of water over a 5 ft x 5 ft cell (0.246 ft3 x 6240 cp/ft3).
waterReturn.evaporationNote: PM_DEFAULT (plan risk 19, flagged for the Owner): one evaporation pass at most every 2400 ticks (one game day), taking up to 1535 cp (about 3 mm) of sky-exposed water from each receiver. A pass runs under the shared work budget and may take longer than a period.
